ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity pixels (white/yellowish regions) to low-intensity pixels (black/dark-grey regions) across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone extends from the peduncle to the notch. High-intensity pixels form two distinct contiguous regions on the lobes; the left lobe shows a large yellowish-white area with significant dark linear overlays, while the right lobe contains a white triangular region with peripheral black speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression; vertical pixel depth from the peak of the trailing edge to the notch apex is approximately 1/6th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire continuous boundary; prominent jagged peaks (10-30 pixel amplitude) occur at the distal tips of both lobes, correlated with high-intensity clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convex curve; the right lobe exhibits a steeper upward sweep towards the terminal tip compared to the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular pixel clusters (dimples and raised white spots) concentrated in the medial yellowish-white region of the left lobe and along the upper margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned dark-pixel paths (rake marks) traversing the high-intensity regions; most prominent are four parallel diagonal lines on the lower section of the left lobe and three horizontal streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (high-contrast, irregular clusters) on the distal tips of both lobes; dense scarring/rake marks distributed across the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Proninent yellowish-tan pixel shift (diatom film) covering approximately 60% of the high-intensity region on the left lobe.
